differences.description: Listener implementations conform to the locked native SDK ABI; native-only callbacks remain edition-scoped.
Native callbacks are delivered to UTS on the platform main thread.

Callbacks settle exactly once; unInit rejects in-flight operations with the existing rejection shape and code -1, invalidates the session epoch, retires adapter listener references, lets Core unInit release native listener state, and drops late callbacks/events.
String arrays and progress payloads use concrete JSON parsers, fixing comma splitting, escaped strings, and substring scanning errors.
Ten frozen Private events are explicitly unsupported on Harmony because the HAR/native ABI has no corresponding methods or callbacks; they must never be reported as bound.
onMessageModified binds EventOnMessageModified rather than EventOnMessageEdited; supported Harmony events bind once per event/epoch and are invalidated before unInit.
